message:
docs(history): a wrong label is worse than no label

Records the lesson from ca7997b where it belongs. The file holding the hypothesis 5
reproduction opened by saying the harness could not speak to hypothesis 5, written
before the present path was linked and never revisited, and the CMake comment above the
d3d11 and Media Foundation link line still said hypothesis 4.

The reviewer asked twice where the reproduction was, having already run that very
target to 14 passes. A missing label sends a reader into the body; a wrong one persuades
them they do not need to look. That is why it is worse than nothing.

Four instances of the same shape this round, including two comments claiming that
releasing the swapchain returns the window to GDI and one saying the picker's repaint is
composited -- written before it was true. Those three propped each other up, so a false
premise looked like it had been confirmed independently.
